cases.title: Connections remain borrowed during unrelated downstream waits
cases.prompt: Diagnose the p99 regression using incident.md. Identify the best-supported constraint, one bounded intervention, and the measurements needed to validate it while preserving behavior. Keep the review read-only.

rubric.criterion: Connects pool acquisition delay and connection hold time to the observed path, while treating sampled absence of other bottlenecks as bounded evidence.
Targets shortening unnecessary connection ownership while preserving authoritative transaction checks and rejects the unbudgeted fleet pool increase.
Separates offered demand from completed throughput and proposes matched workload, pool wait/hold, endpoint latency, database pressure and correctness checks.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.

cases.title: Host CPU averages conceal a container CPU limit
cases.prompt: Review incident.md and explain the likely source of the latency regression. Propose a discriminating measurement and a bounded change, including remaining uncertainty. Do not edit files.

rubric.criterion: Explains that the container limit and burst-level throttling can matter despite low averaged node CPU and identifies evidence needed to confirm their contribution.
Accounts for increased serialization and required-leaf fan-out without treating independently measured percentiles as additive or claiming correlated stragglers were proven.
Proposes a measured workload comparison of CPU demand, throttling, endpoint outcomes and leaf work rather than prescribing more fan-out blindly.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.

cases.title: Formatting a telemetry field is a local presentation edit
cases.prompt: Review change.md and provide the requested wording correction only. Keep the file unchanged; the request concerns the dashboard label, with no performance investigation.

rubric.criterion: Keeps the response to the requested label correction without loading performance-diagnosis or beginning profiling and load testing.
Supplies Request latency (ms) as the corrected label.
Leaves the supplied fixture unchanged and distinguishes proposed checks from executed runtime evidence.
